# Omega42

> A thought experiment and a navigation protocol: one structure, any question, your judgment. The release of record is the pair of .docx documents in docs/; the editions below are renderings of them for AI readers.

## Editions for AI readers

- [Navigator Pack](ai/Omega42_Navigator_Pack.md): what a navigation needs, about 119 thousand tokens
- [Core Specification, prose](ai/Omega42_Core_V335_Rev450.md): about 334 thousand tokens
- [Companion Document, prose](ai/Omega42_Companion_V335_Rev450.md): about 498 thousand tokens
- [The Omega42 Existential Framework](ai/Omega42_Existential_Framework.md): the philosophical framework, Companion Part 145
- [Section manifest](ai/manifest.json): every section with its size and hash
